name: system-design-notes
description: Notes of the book System Desgin Interview - An Insider's Guide
one_liner: A free set of study notes summarizing a popular system-design interview prep book — no code, no product, just a study guide.
buyer: There isn't really a paying buyer here — it's a free study aid a software engineer preparing for interviews might bookmark, not something a business would purchase.
business_use_cases: An individual engineer uses it as free supplementary reading while preparing for big-tech interviews.
A coding bootcamp links to it as a free resource in an interview-prep module.
A content creator references it as a source when making their own paid interview-prep course.

money_ideas.idea: Someone else could turn the notes into a paid, more polished flashcard app or course, but the repo itself has no monetizable product.

steal_this: If anything, use the popularity of this note-taking format as validation to build a proper spaced-repetition flashcard app for system design interviews and sell it for $19.
